verdict.rationale: Antigravity's agent can delegate extensive codebase searches to dedicated subagents and draws context from multi-folder projects (e.g., frontend plus backend repos). Its Planning Mode produces Artifacts, including architecture diagrams and implementation plans, that show how the code fits together and where changes would go. Missing for 10: no explicit documented codebase Q&A/explanation or indexing feature, and no independent or hands-on corroboration of codebase-understanding quality.
